main_text.l: Syr.Idem. Aphel אַחְמִית Excandescere facere, Offen-
חֵימָת Ch. Uter, lagena. Esth.7.10. in Targ. sec. Hebr.
חִנַּג Pahel Ch. Tripudiare, Saltare, Exo.15.20. &32.
חִנָּנָא Ch. Tibia, Fistula, Cithara: Item Chorus. Plur. חִנָּנַיָא, חִנָּנִין.
חַנָּה Hebr. Castrametari : Hospitari, Diversari. Hinc
חַנָּוָא, חַנְוָא Ch.& Syr. Taberna, Officina. Plur. חַנְוָוָן
Act.28.15. emph. חַנְוָתָא Jerem.37.16. cum aff. חַנְוָתִיךְ,
חַנַּט Chald. Aromatibus condire, Balsamare, Gen.
חִטָּה Heb. Syr. Triticum, frumentum, Marc.
חָנַךְ Ch. Initiavit, dedicavit: Item Instruere, Assue-
facere. Unde, כַּר הַוָּא מְחַנַּךְ פּוּמֵיהּ Cùm assueface-
ret os suum, Deut.32.3. in Jon.& T.Hier.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; the vowel points and some Syriac forms are uncertain and may differ in detail. The catchword-like final "חנן" at the foot right is a catchword in Hebrew letters.
